scope: Identified ordinary A-share physical daily rows only; exclude CDR, B shares, ETF/fund/index and unsupported exchanges. Preserve all anomalies and excluded totals separately; no silent deduplication or filling.
other_candidates_separation: For every other candidate, ratio <=0.1 or ratio >=10 for each required date/exchange/field cell
acceptance: Exactly one candidate per field must satisfy all required date/exchange cells and the separation condition. Every required cell needs positive finite official total, explicit original unit/rounding/session/scope, complete compatible local coverage, and no unresolved duplicate/null/exclusion mismatch. Otherwise UNRESOLVED.
unit_gate: Never closes from L4 alone. Requires compatible G2 source definition, reconciled universe/session coverage and independent GPT review.
